references.text: The Amorites held their ground in Har-Heres, Aijalon, and Shaalbim. This text mentions both Aijalon and Shaalbim, which are the same cities mentioned in Joshua 19:42.
Elon from the tribe of Zebulun judged Israel. Aijalon is mentioned as a place name associated with the territory of the tribe of Dan.
Shaalbim is mentioned as part of Solomon's second administrative district, showing the continued importance of this city.
The Valley of Aijalon is the place where Joshua commanded the sun and moon to stand still during the battle against the Amorites.
Aijalon is mentioned as one of the cities given to the Levites from the tribe of Dan.
Aijalon is mentioned in connection with the descendants of Benjamin who lived in the area.
